$comment: The region contract. Every key a storefront can vary lives here and nowhere else. A region file may only use keys defined below; the compiler rejects unknown keys and type mismatches, so a typo fails the build instead of silently rendering an empty string.

id.description: Folder name and build target, e.g. uk

geo_countries.description: ISO country codes routed to this storefront

published.description: Storefront is live. Unpublished regions still compile and can be previewed, but are never advertised to search engines or used as a geo-redirect target.

free_shipping_threshold_cents.description: Cart total in cents unlocking free shipping

shipping_cost_cents.description: Shipping charge in cents below the threshold

logo_url.description: Absolute URL of the logo used in transactional UI

hero_video_url.description: Fallback hero video when the section has no upload

category_label_1.description: First hero category label, e.g. VIBES

category_label_2.description: Second hero category label, e.g. OCCASIONS

social.description: Social profile URLs keyed by network
